title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for paid rate-error review
content:
Enterprise Support — Handling conditions for paid rate-error review.

## Handling condition

For paid rate-error review: This paid rate-error reconciliation applies to full-month, on-demand standard US East source service with approved negotiated support terms and reviewed US untaxed tax treatment. Support service records retain the already official compute export physical quantities for the exact source support invoice; they carry no financial posting. Other products confer no support discount.
